## Pull request overview This PR expands the P11 governance/evidence corpus by adding a fleet-registry invariant test suite, codifying Steering Note ID allocation guidance (including SN-23 date-qualified citation form), and applying a versioning/changelog convention across multiple governance “system” documents. It also adds/updates several milestone artifacts and run records (notably for P11-M38/M39), plus a small shim script to make local-agent-runner invocations reproducible. **Changes:** - Add `tests/test_fleet_registry.py` to enforce invariants over the committed fleet registry (no automation-shaped fields, stable counts, required classification fields, etc.). - Update multiple governance templates/system docs to (a) state SN ID allocation rules and (b) date-qualify SN-23 citations; introduce `version` + `## Changelog` convention on several system documents. - Add/adjust a broad set of `.ai-project/` artifacts and phase docs capturing amendments, review decisions, run metadata, and evidence for P11 milestones. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 90 out of 187 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.
